source_scope: Frozen synthetic cohort measurements, input manifests, model/runtime provenance, and measurement/analysis sources retained for reproduction.
recorded_hash_scope: Hashes embedded in frozen results and summaries refer to original run files before path anonymization. Use this map to resolve original byte/canonical hashes to released files. Do not compare an original hash directly to redacted bytes.
transformations: JSON exports preserve every non-path value and record each anonymized path-string leaf. Retained documentation may be condensed as explicitly marked per file. Measurement source code, synthetic text, numerical results and frozen input selection are unchanged.
model_provenance_scope: Weight/config hashes are recorded external source provenance. No model weights are bundled; offline verification does not reverify external weights.

files.transformation: condensed_protocol_documentation; original source hash retained, frozen rules defined by unchanged manifest and measurement code
